Chapter 672: Chapter 10 Mysterious Black Planet (5000 Words, Please Subscribe)_2

Chapter 672: Chapter 10 Mysterious Black Planet (5000 words, please subscribe)_2

Of course, Lin Yuan couldn’t defeat Nalan, but for the latter to kill the former was no easy feat either.

With the “Step of Space and Time,” even against an Eleventh Rank Powerhouse, Lin Yuan was confident he could escape, leaving Nalan able only to defeat him.

…

He continued to wander around the black planet for a few more laps.

After finding nothing else, Lin Yuan left the planet and returned to the starry sky.

“Let’s see if I can take it into my Inner World.”

...

Looking at the distant black planet, Lin Yuan naturally understood that, based on his current discoveries, the rarity of the black planet was certainly not inferior to that of rare cosmic treasures like the World Tree.

Those twelve black gates that only Grade A Tier 10 could reach undoubtedly contained some kind of opportunity.

Buzzing buzzing buzzing.

The space fluctuated gently.

Even though Lin Yuan exerted his Inner World to the fullest, he couldn’t assimilate the black planet.

The black planet seemed like an ‘anchor,’ firmly connected with countless Spatial Layers.

For Lin Yuan to take the black planet into his Inner World would mean taking this Star Domain and countless Spatial Layers with it.

The difficulty was too great.

And even if Lin Yuan could do it, he would not choose to do so.

Because the commotion caused would be impossible to cover up, taking away large parts of the Star Domain and Spatial Layers at once, likely the Three Goddesses would enquire what Lin Yuan was doing.

…

“Can’t take it into the Inner World?”

Lin Yuan felt it was a bit tricky, which meant he could only leave the black planet there.

Although it hadn’t been discovered by other powerhouses over the years, it didn’t mean it wouldn’t be discovered in the future.

“I can ‘lease’ the nearby Star Domain.”

“That way, I would have the usage rights of all the planets in this Star Domain.”

After pondering for a moment, Lin Yuan thought of a compromise.

As long as it is within the range of the Human Civilization Territory, one must follow the charter laws, and even Eleventh Rank Powerhouses cannot defy it.

Once Lin Yuan became the temporary owner of this Star Domain, theoretically, the black planet would also belong to him.

No one else could claim it, otherwise, it would mean making enemies with Human Civilization.

“Let’s see if this Star Domain has a ‘lessee’.” Lin Yuan immediately started connecting to the Virtual World to check the information of this Star Domain.

This piece of the Star Domain was bleak and desolate, so normally no one would be interested in it.

After all, leasing an entire Star Domain was not cheap.

If this Star Domain had already been leased, then Lin Yuan had reason to believe that others had already discovered the special nature of the black planet.

If so, obtaining the ownership of this black planet would be much more troublesome.

Quickly.

Lin Yuan entered the coordinates of this Star Domain, then waited for the Virtual World network to search.

“Respected Galaxy Master, this Star Domain has not yet got a ‘lessee,’ do you wish to ‘lease’ it?”

A digital mechanical voice came through.

“Lease.” Lin Yuan relaxed and immediately responded.

“This Star Domain has a diameter of 12.35 light-years, please select the leasing period?”

“Ten thousand years.” Lin Yuan thought for a moment.

Ten thousand years in the Main Universe were enough for him to thoroughly unravel the secrets of the black planet.

Even if he hadn’t figured it out by then, Lin Yuan could also choose to extend the leasing period.

“The leasing fee is eight thousand Cubic Universe Crystals, would you like to pay now?” the digital mechanical voice came again.

“Pay.” Lin Yuan quickly said.

Quickly.

The eight thousand Cubic Universe Crystals were transferred away.

And the ownership of this desolate Star Domain fell into Lin Yuan’s name.

Changing ownership of a Star Domain within Human Civilization was nothing out of the ordinary; every second, massive amounts of Star Domain ownerships were being transferred.

Moreover, Lin Yuan chose to hide his information, so his name would not appear on the public listing.

So outsiders would not know that Lin Yuan had acquired this Star Domain.

“It’s done.” A smile appeared on Lin Yuan’s face.

For the next ten thousand years, he would be the master of this Star Domain,

and thus the master of the black planet too.

“Eight thousand Cubic Universe Crystals for this black planet? Worth it, totally worth it.” Lin Yuan felt delighted.

Eight thousand Cubic Universe Crystals were merely the entire fortune of a normal Eighth Layer Evolver, while the exploration threshold for this black planet was Grade A Tier 10.

…

Lin Yuan stood under the starry sky, gazing at the black planet in the distance.

“Actually, to discover this black planet is a rare feat; at least a Tenth Rank Evolver passing by this Star Domain, and happening to be near the black planet, and taking a glance at it, could notice something unusual.” Lin Yuan thought quietly to himself.

Lin Yuan wasn’t your typical Ninth Rank; his perception was no different from a Tenth Rank Evolver.

And Tenth Rank Evolvers? How many were there in the whole of Human Civilization? And considering the vast expanse of the Human Civilization Territory, spanning countless billions of light-years, most Tenth Rank powerhouses traveled using great teleportation across thousands of light-years.

To just happen to land near here was indeed very difficult.

Lin Yuan discovering the anomaly of the black planet owed much to luck.

Was this also Lin Yuan’s “rare encounter”?

As is well known, a “rare encounter” greatly relies on luck.

Without luck, one wouldn’t even notice a “rare encounter” right in front of them.

…

Once again confirming the ownership of this Star Domain, Lin Yuan casually left a monitoring method near the black planet.

Any life form that approached would be swiftly detected by Lin Yuan.

Given the special nature of the black planet, even Lin Yuan couldn’t forcibly move it; other Ninth and Tenth Rank powerhouses trying to stealthily transfer the black planet was tantamount to a fool’s dream.
